notes.title: 🚨 BIG UPDATE: New Visuals, NPCs, Animations, and Puzzles! 🎉
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We're thrilled to bring you a major update for Back To The Collis!

 Over the past few months, we’ve been hard at work making some exciting improvements and additions that we can’t wait to share with you. Here’s what’s new:

[b]🔹 Complete Visual upgrade[/b]
The world of Back To The Collis just got a stunning upgrade! We’ve fine-tuned every environment and atmospheric details to immerse you even more deeply into Benjamin’s journey.

🔹 More NPCs and Interactions
We've added new NPCs to make the world feel even more alive. You’ll encounter new characters with their stories.

🔹 New Animations
The characters in Back To The Collis now move more smoothly and  than ever before. We’ve renewed and added animations to bring more life to every interaction.

🔹 Puzzles 
We've added even more puzzles to challenge you as you explore the game world. 


Keep your eyes peeled, we can’t wait to show you the results of our hard work!
 👀

[b]Updated Announcement Trailer Coming Soon![/b]


🎮 And, Demo Available Very Soon!
 A playable demo is just around the corner, giving you a first-hand experience of all the improvements. 

Stay tuned for more info and the official demo release date.



See you soon in Collis! 🌲🦋




 Back To The Collis Team

notes.title: Back To The Collis Devlog #1: Welcome!
notes.content:
[b]Hello there![/b] 🤗

First of all, I want to express my deep gratitude to everyone who has wishlisted the game and followed us!  You are the ones who are giving us strength and huge motivation to do our best!


[h2]Where are we now? [/h2]
Almost a year ago, we started developing Back To The Collis. We tested several prototypes, created a unique art style for our game, memorable characters, designed engaging and fascinating puzzles, and story-deep narrative.
After having a fully playable first demo version of Back To The Collis, we proceeded to small-scale beta testing to gain actionable insights from players and incorporate those changes into the game.

That's where we are right now! We are fully polishing our demo to deliver the most enjoyable experience for you. 
One of those changes were a complete upgrade of the game's art, adding new characters and puzzles. Briefly, we can't wait to show it to you!

[h2]What's next? [/h2]
After polishing our demo, we will proceed with closed beta testing for the game. If you want to be a part of this testing stage, we would love to have you with us. You can sign up for beta testing [url=https://forms.gle/q9yw6wcgC6bibYjo8]here[/url].
 As soon as beta testing is complete, we will release our free demo on Steam!

 So, check our Steam updates, or join us on [url=https://discord.gg/drqKf3srNV]Discord for discussions[/url].


Love, 

SollersTech
